value.value: The authors associate excess OAm with protonated OAm+ replacing FA+ and disrupting the lattice, insufficient OA with reduced FA-oleate formation, and excess OA with hindered growth and dissolution in washing solvent. These are mechanistic explanations, not measured occupancies, solution structures or reaction stoichiometries.
